title: Review Manifest
description: Schema for machine-checkable human review status, approval scope, and downstream permission semantics.

review_manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this review manifest.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this review_manifest payload.

reviewed_by.description: Reviewer identity or reviewer role identifier.

reviewed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the review decision was recorded.

approval_scope.description: Approved consumer/use-case/country scope for downstream usage.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Jurisdiction labels associated with this review decision.

source_version_refs.description: Referenced source_version identifiers used for provenance.

evidence_refs.description: Referenced evidence artifacts supporting this review decision.

limitations.description: Known limitations attached to this review decision.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether downstream consumption is allowed under this review decision.

expires_at.description: Optional timestamp when this review decision expires.

valid_until.description: Optional timestamp until this review decision is valid.

risk_level.description: Optional risk level assigned during review.

review_method.description: Optional method used to produce final review decision.

metadata.description: Optional local metadata for audit traceability.

workflow_run_id.description: Optional Cloudflare Workflows execution ID that produced or paused at this review manifest.

human_review_gate_status.description: Optional PCRAM pipeline human review gate state. Only present when workflow was involved.

reviewer_id.description: Optional non-PII reviewer identifier (role or handle). Complements reviewed_by for pipeline-generated manifests.

review_timestamp.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of the review decision. Alias of reviewed_at for pipeline-generated manifests.
